title: 本·阿弗莱克谈AI与好莱坞经济

segments.zh: 这是我每次做任何事都会得到的反应。

segments.zh: 只要稍微有点像样，就会有人一脸困惑。

segments.en: Look, does this guy, you've got to be kidding me.
One of the reasons, among many, I want to talk to you is because even prior to that, you had said a lot of very intelligent things about and seemed like someone who had been
segments.zh: 我想和你聊的原因之一，在很多原因中，是因为即使在那之前，你就说过很多非常聪明的见解，看起来像是花了时间做功课的人。

segments.en: spending time doing the work trying to figure it out. So when and how did you decide to start a company and what was the goal?
segments.zh: 那么，你何时以及如何决定创办一家公司，目标是什么？

segments.en: Well, I've had a sort of interest in technology and trying to be in a number of failed attempts to build companies as a sort of a tandem life going back to the early 90s,
segments.zh: 嗯，我对科技一直有兴趣，从90年代初开始，就尝试过多次创业，但都失败了，这算是我的另一条生活线。

segments.en: predating most of the people's lifespan here when I tried to build a non-linear editing company with PCs because the avids are too expensive.
segments.zh: 这比这里大多数人的年龄都早，当时我试图用PC打造一家非线性编辑公司，因为Avid太贵了。

segments.en: That didn't work because the drives are too slow and they drop frames. And then a few years later, but I was always somebody who built computers and like to play with them
segments.zh: 那没成功，因为硬盘太慢，会掉帧。几年后，但我一直是那种自己组装电脑并喜欢摆弄它们的人。

segments.en: and like to program them mostly for games and stuff like that.
segments.zh: 而且喜欢主要把它们用于游戏之类的编程。

segments.en: But I was always interested in it.
segments.zh: 但我一直对此很感兴趣。
